The listing states the flat requires no further outlay and is ready for immediate occupancy; the kitchen has fitted furniture made to measure and a full set of appliances, and the hall and bathroom have built-in wardrobes. The building is insulated and well kept, with a modern lift and an intercom-secured entrance, many publicly available parking spaces around the block, and places in the garage hall offered for an additional payment.
